# Test board of the Layout checks

`si_toolkit_test.kicad_pcb` is a 120 × 90 mm two-layer board with one case for
every check of the **Layout checks** tab, plus a few cases that must **not** be
reported. Its net data (`+5V=2; VIN=5`, group `SD_*`) are in
`si_toolkit_test.si_toolkit.json`, which the plugin reads automatically.
Every case is labelled on the silkscreen with the number of its check.

Open the board in Pcbnew, fill the zones (**B**), open the plugin and press
**Run checks** with the default thresholds. The board was generated by
`si_toolkit/tools/make_test_board.py`.

## Expected rows (21)

| # | Check | Object | Measured / Limit | What the case is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Decoupling | U1.1 (+3V3) | 10.2 / 3 mm (error) | the only capacitor C1 is 10 mm from the supply pin |
| 2 | Layer change | SIG_LC | 5.6 / 2 mm (error) | signal via with no ground via close |
| 3 | Stitching vias | F.Cu + B.Cu (GND) | 29.4 / 7.1 mm (error) | lower right corner left without vias |
| 3 | Stitching vias | F.Cu + B.Cu (GND) | ≈11 / 7.1 mm (warning) | around the plane slot, where the vias are kept away on purpose |
| 4 | Plane gap | PG_SIG | 8 / 5 mm (error) | track over an 8 mm slot of the bottom plane |
| 4 | Plane gap | NA, NB | 19–20 / 5 mm (warnings) | side effect of case 16: each track removes the plane of the other |
| 5 | Plane edge | EDGE_SIG | 0.57 / 4.59 mm (error) | track 1.2 mm from the top board edge |
| 6 | Track width | +5V | 0.25 / 0.78 mm (error) | 0.25 mm track with 2 A |
| 7 | Isolation | GND / HV_400V | 0.30 / 2.5 mm (error) | the top ground pour comes 0.3 mm from the 400 V track |
| 8 | Lengths | USB | 3.5 / 0.5 mm (error) | USB_DM 3.5 mm longer than USB_DP |
| 8 | Lengths | SD_D1 | 5 / 2 mm (error) | SD_D1 5 mm shorter than SD_D0 in group SD_* |
| 9 | Dead branches | DATA | 3 / 1 mm (warning) | 3 mm branch ending in nothing |
| 10 | Acute angles | ACUTE | 17° / 90° (warning) | the track comes back at 17° (RIGHT, at 90°, is not reported) |
| 11 | Width steps | WSTEP | 67 / 25 % (error) | 0.25 mm then 0.15 mm (NECK, a neck-down at the pad, is not reported) |
| 12 | Vias in pads | R3.1 (VIP) | – (warning) | via drill inside the SMD pad |
| 13 | Tombstoning | C9 | – (warning) | GND pad in a zone with solid connection, other pad on a track |
| 14 | Via current | VIN | 2 / 3 via (warning) | 5 A through two 0.3 mm vias |
| 15 | Crystal | XIN | 26 / 10 mm (error) | 26 mm of tracks between Y1 and U15 |
| 15 | Crystal | Y1 / OTHER | – (error) | track of another net under the crystal |
| 16 | Overlapping tracks | NA / NB | 20 / 5 mm (warning) | NA on top over NB on the bottom for 20 mm |

The report (**Report...**) of this board shows all of them with a drawing.

---

## In italiano

Scheda di prova a due layer con un caso per ciascuno dei 16 controlli della
scheda **Controlli layout** (più alcuni casi che **non** devono essere segnalati).
I dati delle net sono nel file `si_toolkit_test.si_toolkit.json`, letto in
automatico dal plugin; ogni caso ha sulla serigrafia il numero del suo controllo.
Apri la scheda, riempi le zone (**B**) e lancia i controlli con le soglie
predefinite: le righe attese sono quelle della tabella qui sopra (21 righe).
